statement: Express $\\sin\\theta+\\sin3\\theta$ as a product, and hence solve $\\sin\\theta+\\sin3\\theta=\\sin2\\theta$ for $\\theta\\in[0,\\pi]$.
solution: $\\sin\\theta+\\sin3\\theta=2\\sin2\\theta\\cos\\theta$. The equation becomes $2\\sin2\\theta\\cos\\theta=\\sin2\\theta$, i.e. $\\sin2\\theta(2\\cos\\theta-1)=0$. So $\\sin2\\theta=0\\Rightarrow\\theta=0,\\tfrac{\\pi}{2},\\pi$, or $\\cos\\theta=\\tfrac12\\Rightarrow\\theta=\\tfrac{\\pi}{3}$. Solutions: $0,\\ \\tfrac{\\pi}{3},\\ \\tfrac{\\pi}{2},\\ \\pi$.
